features.name: Project Setup & Infrastructure
features.description: Next.js 16 bootstrap, Tailwind CSS integration, fonts, and linting rules.

features.name: Vocab Database & Zod Validation
features.description: Zod Schema validation for vocab JSON data database format.

features.name: Word Typing Practice Mode
features.description: Real-time checking typing input vs current word with stats (WPM, Accuracy, Errors).

features.name: Practice Timer & Settings
features.description: Adjustable session timer with custom limit, start, and end triggers.

features.name: Result Summary Modal
features.description: Overlay dialog summarizing typing performance (WPM, Accuracy, error items) at session end.

features.name: Smart Spaced Repetition (SRS)
features.description: Track typing progress, mistake streaks, and weight words dynamically for learning.

features.name: Sentence Typing Practice
features.description: Practice typing full sentences based on vocabulary example usage.

features.name: Interactive Build-a-Sentence
features.description: Interactive drag-and-drop or token assembly practice mode for learning grammar patterns.

features.name: Stats & Progress Dashboard
features.description: Dedicated analytics screen detailing master/learning stats, mistake history, and review curves.

features.name: JSON Import & Export Backup
features.description: Save/restore localStorage learning progress, mistake history, and user settings to local backup files.

features.name: Speech Synthesis Pronunciation
features.description: Click/auto audio speak capabilities using Web Speech API synthesis for active pronunciation training.

features.name: Curriculum Engine & Schema Reader
features.description: Implement data models, Zod validation schema, and dynamic loader for lessons, chunks, activities, and targets.

features.name: Curriculum Content: Foundation (L01-L06)
features.description: Load Phase 1 foundation lessons including 'Be or Do', subject pronouns, plurals, and basic question/negative patterns.

features.name: Core Learning Activities (Concept, Classify, Fill-in-blank, Reorder)
features.description: Develop UI components for basic activities: concept reading, category classification, gap-filling, and word reordering.

features.name: Lesson Progress & Error Analytics
features.description: Track LessonProgress state (locked/learning/mastered) and record categorized error tags (missing_be, wrong_tense, spelling) to store in history.

features.name: Curriculum Content: Time & Communication (L07-L18)
features.description: Load Phase 2 (Time, Continuous vs Simple, Past Simple, Future) and Phase 3 (Connectives, Adjectives/Adverbs, Polite requests, Small talk) lessons.

features.name: Advanced Activities (Transform, Dictation, Reading)
features.description: Develop UI components for grammar transform practice, audio dictation typing, and technical reading comprehension analysis.

features.name: Curriculum Content: Coding & AI Stand-up (L19-L24)
features.description: Load Phase 4 technical scenarios (explaining functions, instructions/READMEs, stand-up updates, explaining bugs, AI project presentation) lessons.

features.name: Monthly Assessment Dashboard & Metrics
features.description: Design an assessment subsystem measuring comprehensibility, response latency, and grammatical precision across five core areas.

features.name: AI Tutor Integration & Conversational Feedback
features.description: Integrate interactive AI Tutor supporting balanced/strict/gentle modes, roleplaying daily workflows, and providing structural corrections.

features.name: Apple Music UI Overhaul
features.description: Redesign website views (Navbar, Home, Today practice page, and Stats dashboard) using Apple Music design system tokens from DESIGN.md.

features.name: Hume AI UI Overhaul
features.description: Redesign website views using Hume AI design system tokens from DESIGN.md, including layout, navigation, scorecards, custom pastel mistake bars, and flat buttons.
